name: abl_deltafield_turnover
description: DeltaField-RankBind on the BRENDA+SABIO turnover_number (kcat) decoy-augmented dataset. BASELINE negatives (cross_protein_implicit). One weight-shared bipartite ESM2-residue x ChemBERTa-atom transformer run twice (free vs coupled mask); the binding score is read ONLY from the difference field D = H_coupled - H_free, so the protein-prior shortcut is a structural zero of the score. Requires per-token ChemBERTa + per-residue ESM2 (attn_pool). Model block copied from abl_deltafield.json; data block inherited from datasets/turnover_with_decoys.json.

_notes.role: Turnover-scale baseline for the deltafield head; the hard-negative variant is abl_deltafield_turnover_hard.json.
_notes.zero_field_invariant: prop_layers=0 keeps the exact invariant; see v5_rankbind/tests/test_deltafield.py.
_notes.storage: per-token ChemBERTa cache lives on /work2 (rankbind_bench workspace); ESM2 per-residue store stays on the home shared store (loader follows symlinks).
